description: TN government partners with IIT Madras to create an AI Data Centre, establishing a PMU to render state applications AI-ready.
body_lead: The Tamil Nadu government on Thursday partnered with IIT Madras to establish a Project Monitoring Unit (PMU) to oversee the creation of an Artificial Intelligence (AI) Data Centre for the Tamil Nadu government. A Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) was signed on Thursday at the Secretariat between ELCOT and the IITM Pravartak Technologies Foundation (IIT Madras) in the presence of the Minister for Artificial Intelligence, Information Technology, and Digital Services, R. Kumar.
